verified_installed_source_facts: CacheConfig and TritonAttentionBackend both include int8_per_token_head.
Actual KVQuantMode.INT8_PER_TOKEN_HEAD is2, is_per_token_head True; this is integer cache storage, not FP8 hardware arithmetic.
Backend native cache shape pads head128 to132 int8 elements; last4 bytes perhead hold FP32 scale.
Native _ensure_scale_caches assumes contiguous NHD padded132 layout; HND/strided INT8 must not be presumed supported.
Native per-token-head writer computes absmax/127 scale, round-half-away-from-zero/clamp then int8 stores. Query and weights remain BF16.
Unified attention converts integer K/V tiles to query dtype and applies per-token scales to QK scores and P before PV.

Current adopted hybrid supported() rejects non-BF16 K/V and non-NONE quant mode. Current .cv decode launch guard also requires KV_QUANT_MODE0/BF16. A naive int8 switch loses adopted routing/tile choices; it is not a clean scalar config comparison.
